items.t: ExxonMobil Secures Government Approval for Revised Rovuma LNG Plan
items.sum: XOM secures Mozambique's approval for a revised Rovuma LNG plan, lifting capacity to 18.6 MTPA while targeting lower costs and emissions.

items.t: TechnipFMC Deepens ExxonMobil Ties With Guyana Longtail Awards
items.sum: FTI deepens its XOM partnership with two Guyana Longtail awards, expanding subsea work as the $12.5B offshore project targets 2030 production.

items.t: ETFs Are Net Sellers of ExxonMobil (XOM) on Nov. 18
items.sum: ETFs sold $305.7 million of ExxonMobil on Wednesday, Nov. 18, with 32 funds buying and 26 selling.

items.t: ExxonMobil Sinks 11% in a Month as Oil Slides. Darren Woods Says Its Earnings Power Comes From “Lasting Improvements”
items.sum: Key TakeawaysExxonMobil shares are down 11% in the past month as oil prices fell on hopes for an end to the Iran war, alongside a broad market selloff. Refining earned more than half of Exxon’s third-quarter adjusted profit, and the market treats that kind of windfall as temporary.

items.t: ExxonMobil Holdings (XOM) Gets Mozambique Approval For $30 Billion Rovuma LNG Plan
items.sum: ExxonMobil Holdings (NYSE:XOM) secured Mozambican government approval for its redesigned Rovuma LNG project, a roughly US$30b development. The revised Rovuma LNG plan includes higher production capacity and a layout aimed at materially lower emissions compared with the earlier concept.
